title: Typed dependencies, permission checks, and human approval
description: Tools receive program-supplied dependencies through RunContext[Deps] and combine schema validation, a domain check, a permission check, and human approval.

steps.description: Deps holds today's date, the notes_dir folder, and the set of allowed_courses. The Agent declares deps_type=Deps and allows DeferredToolRequests as an output type when a tool pauses for approval.
days_until reads ctx.deps.today and raises ModelRetry if the target date is more than a year ahead, sending a correction back to the model.
save_deadline checks whether course is in ctx.deps.allowed_courses, raises ApprovalRequired() if the call is not yet approved, and only then appends the deadline to the course file.
